proposal.reason: The substantive change is a broad rewrite of open-source test workflow behavior: dual-platform (M890P/810E) case generation/grouping, runner allocation/device mapping, SDK install/validation handoff, reconciliation/reporting/artifact handling, and corresponding xtest tooling and fixtures. Workflow-file renames/docs edits and large patch-omitted test-list JSONs are part of this same CI execution/reporting surface rather than separate module policy or product-runtime ownership.
